changelog:
- [UI/UX] Added immediate, zero-network-overhead local video/audio playback preview to the Format Converter tab before processing.
- [UI/UX] Integrated premium, glassmorphic custom confirmation dialogs for "Clear Temp Cache" and "Reset UI Settings" actions.
- [UI/UX] Added an elegant close/dismiss button to the Authentication (Cookies) Upload panel with automatic settings toggle synchronization.
- [UI/UX] Removed redundant Reset UI button from Global Settings to keep the settings menu clean.
- [Bug Fix] Enforced full-width layout for the Media Library empty state message to prevent awkward text wrapping inside the history grid.
